title: Firefly
summary: Created an esports brand concept for the first-person shooter VALORANT, including logo design, brand guidelines, graphic assets, and a promotional video.

meta.Software: Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, Blender
meta.Deliverables: Logo, brand guidelines, graphic assets, promotional video

blocks.label: Overview
blocks.heading: An esports brand, built end to end.
paras: I developed an esports brand concept for the popular first-person shooter VALORANT as a personal project, designing the logo, brand guidelines, graphic assets, and producing a promotional video.

blocks.label: Brand mark
blocks.heading: Drawn for animation from the start.
paras: I explored brand name ideas, focusing on animals and insects, and chose Firefly for its distinctive traits to tie my outcomes visually. Inspired by the top Esports logos, I chose a minimalist style for the brand mark, thoughtfully designed with 2D animation in mind.

blocks.label: 3D models
blocks.heading: In-game assets, re-lit and re-shot.
paras: For the video, I extracted the in-game 3D models and imported their existing animations, replacing their original textures with custom monochromatic ones. I then animated multiple camera angles per scene to sequentially showcase all five characters, emphasizing their unique abilities recolored.
